caption: The drawing depicts a decorative object resembling a fruit bouquet or arrangement set in a footed pedestal bowl. The composition includes multiple green leaves positioned around and between the fruits. At the top center, there is a round, light beige fruit with red and black markings radiating from its center. Below it, a yellow, dotted, oval-shaped fruit sits centrally, flanked on either side by two red, heart-shaped fruits with visible segment lines. Toward the base of the arrangement, there are three dark brown or black round fruits, each set above additional green leaves. On each side, there are smaller oval fruits, orange with a central dark line, partially embedded in the leaves. The container holding the arrangement is gray and rendered with shading to suggest three-dimensional form. The background is plain and beige, constituting the uncolored paper, enclosed within a simple drawn rectangular border.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Mantel Stop
